target.title: chore(deps): refresh site dependencies
target.body:
## Summary

- update Astro from 7.0.4 to 7.1.0
- update Lucide Astro from 1.22.0 to 1.24.0
- update Simple Icons from 16.24.1 to 16.26.0
- refresh the Bun lockfile and existing Unreleased dependency entry

## Upstream review

- [Astro 7.1.0](https://github.com/withastro/astro/releases/tag/astro%407.1.0) adds bounded build/runtime features and fixes.
- Lucide Astro 1.24.0 retains Astro 7 peer compatibility.
- [Simple Icons 16.26.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/releases/tag/16.26.0) adds two icons.

## Exact-head proof

Commit: `a45fcb59d7adc80b95af4a163d9ca6107da633a4`

- `bun install --frozen-lockfile`: passed
- `bun outdated`: no outdated direct dependencies
- `bun audit`: no vulnerabilities found
- `bun test`: 39 pass, 0 fail
- `bun run test:built-assets`: passed; 31 pages built
- `git diff --check`: passed
- branch AutoReview against `origin/main`: clean; correctness confidence 0.96
- GitHub install matrix: Linux jobs passed; install smoke jobs passed except the default-branch `install-sh-unit` regression tracked by #215

## Remaining gates

Both exact-head Vercel deployments fail about two seconds after creation, before a preview URL or build log is emitted:

- clawd-bot: `dpl_ydK4xuDieh9SXLre7fPsyxhohQAR`
- openclaw.ai: `dpl_A1BdEp3strd1DsaZvQCbiAZzFrxj`

This is a pre-build deployment gate, not an observed Astro build failure. Authenticated Vercel logs are unavailable in this worker lane, so the exact rejection reason remains unproven. The updated exact head also lacks real-browser proof because the configured Chrome bridge is unavailable.

Merge remains blocked pending successful exact-head hosted previews and browser proof, plus #215 landing and a clean CI rerun.

Risk: medium. The dependency diff is bounded and locally green, but Astro 7.1 is a minor build/runtime update and both production-like deployment paths are currently unobserved.
